display_name: Phase1 复数增益反事实源域诊断
description: 在源训练配对样本上，以干净 IQ 求最小二乘复数增益，诊断简单盲均衡路线的可能性。
authorization: 用户要求研发更强星地恢复网络并严格限定 Phase1 地面训练、测试与 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL 基座。

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI Python/Torch CPU only, original Phase1 frozen Tri-SIG-TIME release

data.representation: Paired Phase1 source clean and received IQ, fixed frozen DURA native outputs
data.label_map_ref: Phase1 six TX classes; hidden throughout restorer training
data.tx_sets_ref: Six original classes; no TX labels in restorer training
data.validation_ref: Existing complete R07 source cache, IDs compared with Tri-SIG-TIME source contract
data.support_query_ref: Phase1 original fixed cross_rx126000 and cross_both42000; no support
data.leo_config_ref: R07 2.462 GHz source views and Phase1 six fixed practical test views
data.actual_training_labels: No TX labels, V or test IQ

permissions.regime: Phase1 L_s/U_s source IQ only, no labels, frozen original teacher and DURA
permissions.claim_scope: Privileged paired source counterfactual, not test accuracy or other-model ceiling

checkpoint.initialization: Frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL E50 and original DURA E20 source native predictions
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Pinned source producer launch, exact 128 L +384 U deterministic positions, role IDs and clean arrays
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Phase1-only source outputs; no old classifier decisions consumed
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed 512 source IDs and fixed views 01/20; no selection by test outcomes

execution.stop_rule: Source ID mismatch, zero energy, nonfinite outputs, changed teacher or output collision stops and preserves evidence

metrics_plan.targets_ref: paired clean source IQ and teacher predictions only

notes: 固定 Phase1 源训练 512 个物理 ID（L_s 128、U_s 384），两个既有源视图 01/20；核对 ID、角色与干净 IQ 的物理配对。
每条接收 IQ 使用不可部署的配对 clean IQ 求最小二乘单个复数增益，比较原始、DURA、特权标量输出的相对 clean teacher 一致性及归一化 IQ 误差。
此实验使用特权 clean，只是源训练集反事实；teacher 一致性不是 TX 真值准确率，结果不是其他方法的性能上界。不读任何 TX 标签、V 或测试 IQ，不做模型更新。

rows.method: Privileged clean-paired complex scalar least squares
rows.purpose: Distinguish source mismatch explainable by one complex gain from residual impairments
rows.seed_notes: Fixed existing source positions and views; no stochastic sampling
rows.budget_ref: 512 fixed source records x two views; frozen teacher, no updates
